title: Flateau (Building footprint data in Japan)
description: We prepared data for each city where original Plateau (National government open data project) CityGML data are available in 2024/05. The Plateau project keeps adding more cities every year. So, hopefully we can keep adding more cities in the future. You can download data as geoparquet or geopackage formats and use our data freely under CC-BY 4.0 license.
